title: rename grill->spec across cam-owned surface (decouple vocabulary from Matt Pocock)
description:
Desvincular o vocabulario de SUPERFICIE do cam da terminologia 'grill' (vendorada do Matt Pocock): chamar de 'spec' em todos os artefatos cam-owned. Diretiva do operador 2026-06-30, durante a sessao de spec do CAM-145.

BOUNDARY DURO: as skills /grilling e /domain-modeling sao vendoradas do mattpocock/skills; NAO renomear (forkaria upstream). O wrapper grill-with-docs invoca /grilling por nome: essa chamada interna permanece. So muda o vocabulario de superficie do cam (wrapper, comandos, agent files, docs, enum), nao a chamada vendorada.

BLAST RADIUS (medido 2026-06-30): ~22 arquivos cam-owned referenciam 'grill'. Superficie de docs/instrucao: .claude/commands/cam-plan.md (10 refs) + templates/, .claude/commands/cam-spec.md (8) + templates/, .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md + templates/, .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md + templates/, .claude/skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md (2) + templates/, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (2), scripts/cam/patterns.md, docs/recovery-runbook.md. Schema/codigo: enum specSource 'grill' em src/issues/types.ts, src/issues/spec.ts (+ logica back-compat absent=>grill), src/issues/alloc.ts, src/commands/issue-file.ts, e o ramo back-compat do cam-plan Step 2. Dado: 0 issues tem specSource:'grill' EXPLICITO (todos usam o default-por-ausencia), entao NAO ha migracao de arquivos de issue, so de codigo/default.

DECISOES DE DESIGN PRA SPEC TIME:
1. Valor do enum: specSource 'grill' renomeia pra que? (candidatos: 'spec', 'interview', 'specified'). Atualizar o default (absent=>X) e manter leitura graciosa de dado antigo. Considerar semver (mudanca de schema).
2. Skill grill-with-docs: renomear diretorio/arquivo (ex: spec-with-docs)? cam-spec.md le por path: atualizar referencia + dual-copy (.claude + templates) + embed.
3. Politica de ADR: docs/adr/0001+0002 mencionam 'grill' como registro historico append-only. Recomendacao a validar: deixar como esta (ADR e ponto-no-tempo), nao reescrever retroativamente.
4. Docs vivas (scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md, patterns.md, recovery-runbook): atualizar referencias pra 'spec'.

MECANICA: todo .md tocado tem copia em templates/ + embed src/vendor/_generated.ts; rodar bun run embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check; testes de paridade classe CAM-49/68/79.

RELACAO: CAM-145 (clausula recommend-on-merits) shipa primeiro e e rename-neutra (texto fala 'recommendation', nao 'grill'); este issue rebaseia nela. Relacionado: CAM-64 (Mulch knowledge central), CAM-144 (fast-track/specSource), cam-dual-copy-is-per-file.

spec.scope: Rename the 'grill' SURFACE vocabulary to 'spec'/'interview' across all cam-owned artifacts, decoupling cam's vocabulary from the vendored Matt Pocock terminology. Three work fronts: (A) rename the specSource enum value 'grill' -> 'interview' in schema + code; (B) rename the skill directory grill-with-docs -> spec-with-docs (both dual-copies) + regenerate the vendor embed; (C) rename grill->spec/interview references in living surface docs. HARD BOUNDARY: the vendored skills .claude/skills/grilling/ and .claude/skills/domain-modeling/ (and templates/ copies) are upstream Pocock and MUST NOT be renamed; the by-name /grilling and /domain-modeling invocation on line 7 of the (renamed) spec-with-docs SKILL.md MUST survive verbatim. OUT OF SCOPE: append-only history (ADRs docs/adr/0001,0002,0012,0033; scripts/cam/journal.md; scripts/cam/journal.archive.md; CHANGELOG.md) is left untouched as point-in-time record; no new ADR is written for this rename.
acceptanceCriteria: FRONT A (schema/code, enum 'grill' -> 'interview'): src/issues/types.ts:50 specSource type becomes 'interview' | 'derived' | 'operator'. src/issues/spec.ts: isValidSpecSourceEnum (:55-56) accepts 'interview' (NOT 'grill'); the absent-default (:92-93 `specSource === undefined ? 'grill'`) becomes 'interview'; the error string (:89) lists 'interview', 'derived', 'operator'. Type literals updated in src/issues/alloc.ts (:76,:130), src/commands/issue-file.ts (:60), index.ts (:2115,:2169,:2226). Code comments mentioning 'grill' updated in src/commands/issue-specify.ts, src/commands/spec.ts:332, src/commands/domain-docs.ts:35, src/config/models.ts:51, src/supervisor/events.ts:308,310.

FRONT A back-compat: NO legacy 'grill' acceptance branch is added. isValidSpecSourceEnum rejects the string 'grill' after this change. Rationale: zero issue files carry explicit specSource:'grill' (the 6 explicit ones are 4 derived + 2 operator), so a legacy-accept branch would be dead code for an impossible input. No issue-file data migration is performed.

FRONT A tests: test/issues/spec.test.ts updated so isValidSpecSourceEnum accepts 'interview' and rejects 'grill'; the absent-default resolves to 'interview'; the error-message assertion lists the new triad. Any other test asserting the old enum value is updated.

FRONT B (skill directory rename): .claude/skills/grill-with-docs/ AND templates/skills/grill-with-docs/ are both renamed to spec-with-docs/. The SKILL.md `name:` frontmatter (line 2) becomes spec-with-docs in both copies. Line 7 of that SKILL.md ('Run a /grilling session, using the /domain-modeling skill') is preserved verbatim (the /grilling and /domain-modeling tokens are the vendored by-name calls and must NOT change).

FRONT B by-path references updated: .claude/commands/cam-spec.md:24 and templates/commands/cam-spec.md:24 load the skill by path -> update `.claude/skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md` to `.claude/skills/spec-with-docs/SKILL.md`. docs/recovery-runbook.md by-path mentions (lines ~1688, ~1833, ~1839) updated.

FRONT B embed regeneration: after the directory rename, run bun run embed-vendor (regenerates src/vendor/_generated.ts so the embedded keys change from skills/grill-with-docs/SKILL.md to skills/spec-with-docs/SKILL.md, and the inlined commands/cam-spec.md text updates). _generated.ts is autogenerated: NEVER hand-edit it. bun run embed-vendor:check passes and test/embedded.test.ts passes (on-disk == embedded).

FRONT C (living surface docs, grill -> spec/interview prose): .claude/commands/cam-spec.md (9 refs across lines 1,7,9,22,24,35,95,97 -- excluding the /grilling call which does not appear there) + template copy; scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md:110 (2 refs: 'grill layer', 'grill session'); scripts/cam/patterns.md:582 (1 ref: 'grill-with-docs' skill name -> spec-with-docs); docs/recovery-runbook.md prose (~15 refs incl the section heading); README.md:135 ('via grill-with-docs'); CONTEXT.md:243 ('the /cam-spec grill interview'); index.ts CLI help/description strings (lines 112, 278, 319, 381: 'via grill-with-docs interview', 're-grilled', etc.).
Dual-copy parity holds: every touched .md under .claude/ has its templates/ twin updated identically; the CAM-49/68/79-class embed/parity tests pass.
Quality gates green: bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all, bun run embed-vendor:check.

Do NOT chase these phantom sites. Conversely, new code surfaces exist that the issue did not list: src/commands/spec.ts, issue-specify.ts, domain-docs.ts, src/supervisor/events.ts, src/config/models.ts.

HARD BOUNDARY: .claude/skills/grilling/ (name+description frontmatter contain 'grill', body is pure Pocock) and .claude/skills/domain-modeling/ and both templates/ copies are VENDORED UPSTREAM (provenance: mattpocock/skills, recorded in the worker event log). They are NOT renamed. The /grilling and /domain-modeling by-name invocation inside the renamed spec-with-docs SKILL.md (line 7) is preserved verbatim.

The absent-default is the LIVE common path, not back-compat: most issue files have no specSource field, so `specSource === undefined ? 'interview'` is exercised on nearly every read. Renaming this default value is required and is the one behavior-touching line; it is logically low-risk because the 'grill'/'interview' branch carries no derivedFrom/description invariant (it is effectively a provenance label).

ADR 0002 defines the original specSource:'grill' semantics + the absent=>grill rule as HISTORICAL record. Leave it (and 0001/0012/0033) untouched: retroactively rewriting an append-only point-in-time ADR falsifies history. No new ADR either (an enum-value rename is reversible and fails the hard-to-reverse ADR gate).

_generated.ts is AUTOGENERATED (header warns: run bun scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts / bun run embed-vendor after editing vendor/ or templates/). Do NOT hand-edit it; regenerate and run the parity check. All three vendored skill trees are currently byte-identical across .claude/ and templates/ (verified by diff) -- keep them identical after the rename.

specSource enum value chosen is 'interview' (accurate provenance word parallel to derived/operator, non-tautological), NOT 'spec' (which would read circularly as specSource:'spec'). The surface DOCS vocabulary is 'spec'; only the enum value is 'interview'. Do not conflate the two.
